story.conflict: An employee must choose whether keeping the boss's secret justifies charging an unsuspecting wife for another woman's dinner.
story.hook: My boss told me to put his girlfriend's dinner on his wife's bill. His wife had booked their anniversary table for that evening.
story.like_cta: LIKE IF THAT BILL NEEDED THE TRUTH
story.premise: A restaurant boss asks an employee to charge his girlfriend's dinner to his wife's bill on the evening of their anniversary meal.
story.punchline: Neither woman was still waiting for him.
story.script: Claire waited at table seven with a small gift box. Her husband, Martin, would join her after the kitchen rush. Then he brought a woman to the bar and introduced her to me, quietly, as his girlfriend. He told me to move her food onto Claire's tab. I asked whether Claire knew. He said his marriage wasn't my concern and I should just handle the bill. When Claire asked whether Martin's meal was ready, I said I needed to confirm which meals belonged on her account. She asked what I meant. I told her he'd asked me to add the bar order. She asked the woman whether she was dining with her husband. The woman said Martin had told her they were separated. Martin came out of the kitchen and said we'd all misunderstood a simple arrangement. Claire asked whether the anniversary booking had been part of that misunderstanding too. He told me to stop standing there and get back to work. I went to print a bill for the meal Claire had actually ordered. She paid it, picked up the unopened box, and left. The other woman told Martin to pay for the dinner he'd invited her to, then left too. I didn't know what he would do about my next shift. I cleared two places. Neither woman was still waiting for him.
story.twist: The girlfriend has also been told the marriage is over, so neither woman has agreed to the arrangement the boss wants the employee to conceal.

youtube.description: The wife expects an anniversary dinner. The employee is asked to hide another woman's meal on her bill.
youtube.title: The Gift Box at Table Seven

story.conflict: A father must confront his own part in academic dishonesty when fear about school fees makes him pressure his son to continue cheating.
story.hook: I told my son to keep using the test answers his tutor gave him. I didn't want to lose the scholarship his fake scores had helped him get.
story.like_cta: LIKE IF HELP SHOULD MEAN LEARNING
story.premise: A father tells his son to keep using test answers supplied by his tutor because the resulting grades helped secure an important scholarship.
story.punchline: This time, I asked him to show me where he got stuck.
story.script: Ben put the answer sheet beside his homework. He was tired of pretending he understood everything. His tutor also taught at his school. She'd been giving him answers before tests, and the high marks had helped him win a fee scholarship. I asked him to keep using them until we could work out the money. He asked whether I wanted him to learn or keep getting the marks. We couldn't afford the fees without the award. He showed me a question he couldn't start. I pointed to the answer, and he covered it with his hand. He wanted me to explain how to get there. I couldn't. When I called the tutor, she said every parent wanted results and I should be grateful she understood our situation. I heard my own excuse coming back from someone I'd paid. I told her the arrangement was stopping. Then I told Ben I had been wrong to ask him to continue, after he'd asked me for help. I contacted the school and explained how the marks had been obtained, and what I'd told him to do. They said the scholarship would need reviewing. I didn't know how we'd manage. That evening, Ben opened his book without the answer sheet. I sat beside him. This time, I asked him to show me where he got stuck.
story.twist: The child is asking for help learning honestly, while the parent who should protect that choice has become another person pressuring him to perform.

youtube.description: His son's scholarship has made the fees manageable. The father has to face what he asked his child to do to keep it.
youtube.title: The Answer Sheet Beside His Homework

story.conflict: A tenant must reclaim independent access when the landlord removes an agreed adaptation and presents paid dependence on him as help.
story.hook: My landlord removed the wheelchair ramp I'd paid for. Then he offered to carry me inside for a daily fee.
story.like_cta: LIKE IF INDEPENDENCE IS NOT AN UPSELL
story.premise: A landlord removes a wheelchair ramp his tenant paid for and offers to carry the tenant inside for a daily fee.
story.punchline: This time, my own key was enough.
story.script: I came home to the steps where the ramp had been. Peter opened the door and said the entrance looked tidier without it. I asked where he'd put it. He said it was in his garage, and I shouldn't worry because he could help me inside. Then he named a daily price. I asked why I'd pay him for something I'd done myself that morning. He said needing help was part of my situation. I told him I'd already arranged that help by paying an installer for the ramp he'd agreed could be there. He said I was making a generous offer sound unreasonable. I called the installer beside Peter. He could come over. Had Peter reported a problem with the ramp? Peter said no, he just preferred the entrance without it. I asked him to open the garage. He said putting it back would cost money. I said I wasn't paying twice because he'd changed his mind about something we'd agreed. When the installer arrived, Peter finally unlocked the garage. I waited while they put the ramp back and told Peter to discuss that bill with the person whose work he'd removed. He offered his hand when I went toward the door. I said I would ask when I wanted help. Then I went inside. This time, my own key was enough.
story.twist: The supposed need for his assistance exists because he removed the ramp, which is still sitting in his garage.

youtube.description: The tenant has already paid for independent access. The landlord removes it and offers a different service at a daily price.
youtube.title: The Ramp Inside His Landlord's Garage

story.conflict: A bride must reclaim her ring without accepting the magician's claim that protecting his girlfriend's romantic moment justifies keeping it.
story.hook: Our wedding magician swapped my engagement ring for a fake, then proposed to his girlfriend with mine. She thought he'd bought it for her.
story.like_cta: LIKE IF BORROWING DOES NOT MEAN OWNING
story.premise: A wedding magician swaps the bride's engagement ring for a fake and uses the real one to propose to his girlfriend, who thinks he bought it for her.
story.punchline: The next applause was for our first dance.
story.script: He'd borrowed it for his trick and handed a ring back to applause. I looked inside the band and couldn't find our initials. He called his girlfriend up and went down on one knee. I recognized my ring in the open box. She said yes. He called our photographer over. I walked over and said we needed to finish his trick first. I'd get mine back after the photographs, he whispered. I asked whether his girlfriend knew it wasn't his to give. She asked what I meant. I showed her the ring he'd returned to me and asked whether she could check the initials inside hers. They were mine and my husband's. She said he'd told her he'd saved for months to buy it. He said he'd wanted the proposal to be special and couldn't afford a ring like that yet. Then he told me I was embarrassing her by making a scene. She took the ring off herself and handed it to me. She said he could stop answering for her, too. He asked whether they could at least take the picture before everyone moved on. She said they needed a conversation first. I wasn't deciding their engagement for her, but my ring wasn't staying in the photograph. My husband took my hand when the music started again. The next applause was for our first dance.
story.twist: The girlfriend is another person deceived by the proposal, and she chooses to return the borrowed ring rather than pose as its new owner.

youtube.description: The bride's ring returns from the trick without its initials. Then the magician opens a proposal box for someone else.
youtube.title: The Initials Inside the Magician's Proposal
